Hymn 142: Sweet Hour of Prayer
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: William B. Bradbury
Lyricist/Text Author: William W. Walford
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 142 titled "Sweet Hour of Prayer" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William B. Bradbury and the lyrics were written by William W. Walford.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
